//! A `macro_rules!` definition. Its expansion is invisible to the parse,
//! so it is refused rather than read.

fn base_s() -> i64 {
    std::time::SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
        .expect("clock")
        .as_secs() as i64
}

macro_rules! helper {
    () => {
        std::time::SystemTime::now()
    };
}
